name: Hills Footer
summary: A footer whose headline and call to action sit over a canvas landscape of rolling hills that rise, drift with mist and follow the pointer, with link columns, a newsletter field and social links below.
useWhen: A marketing or support page needs a warm closing call to action above the site links
A brand wants a landscape feel without shipping any image files
avoidWhen: The footer must stay compact or sit on a dense app screen, because the scene takes most of the first viewport; use a plain footer instead
The page needs a serif headline, because the accent is set in Geist italic, not a separate serif face
